purpose: Machine-readable mapping of every Grok artifact/run in the repository: old (recorded) identity -> canonical identity -> status. Historical identifiers are preserved; the canonical identity is operator-reported, never upgraded to independently verified.

canonical_configuration.identity_evidence_note: Operator-observed/operator-reported only (recorded Tasks 021/026 header edits + identity notes). Not independently verifiable from provider metadata in these records; never upgraded to verified model identity.

historical_exception.note: No 'Grok Build' configuration exists anywhere in the repository records (prompt files, manifests, plans, rosters, reports, docs, git history all checked). The one early historical Grok condition (EXP-001/EXP-002, August 2026, run exp002__2026-08-31__unknown__grok__unknown) was genuinely unannotated at the time and is preserved as recorded ('unknown'). If a Grok Build session exists outside these records, it is not part of EXP-004 and is not affected by this map.

status_legend.genuinely_unknown: identity genuinely unrecorded and NOT part of the current experimental line; preserved as unknown
status_legend.conflicting_metadata: filename vs internal metadata conflict — none remain after Task 031
status_legend.superseded_by_regeneration: pre-regeneration identifier of an uncollected deterministic kit; replaced by the canonical identifier (same date, same content otherwise)
